title: pbs-parity-envelope/1
description: One parity case. The runner posts the identical envelope to POST /__parity/exec on the Go and the Rust server. The server rebuilds the inbound HTTP request from 'request', runs it through its full outer handler chain (compression, NoCache, CORS, router) while a trace session is active, and answers with a pbs-parity-trace/1 document.

fixture_path.description: Repo-relative provenance of the seed fixture, if any.

profile.description: Config profile the servers were started with.

decisions.description: Pinned values for decision points (decisions.json). Absent points use the real random source and are reported with source 'rng'.

ExecRequest.description: The inbound request. headers keep wire order and case; remote_addr becomes the request's RemoteAddr (host:port); host overrides the Host header.

mode.description: oracle (default): outbound calls go to the runner's oracle proxy. inline: outbound calls are answered in-process from 'inline'.

level.description: http (default): real adapters over (mocked) HTTP. bidder_response: MakeRequests runs and is recorded, no HTTP request is sent, and bidder_responses[bidder] is used as the MakeBids output exactly once per bidder.

InlineMocks.description: Resolution order: rules (first match); then bidders[bidder] or default_bidder for bidder calls, cache for cache calls, kinds[kind] for other kinds. Built-in defaults: bidder 204, cache 503, anything else the transport error 'parity: network disabled'.

InlineRule.description: Every non-empty matcher must match. uri_regex is RE2 syntax and is matched against the original (pre-rewrite) URL.

InlineResponse.description: Canned response. status defaults to 200. delay_ms waits (honouring the client's deadline) before answering. fail makes the call fail instead: timeout waits for the client deadline (or fails with a timeout error when there is none), refused/reset simulate connection errors.

BidderResponseMock.description: Replacement MakeBids output (adapters.BidderResponse plus the error list). nil_response makes MakeBids return no response object, only errors.

stages.description: "*" (default) or the list of stage IDs to record.
